newsitem.title: UK: Forth Ports to place 2.28 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Forth Ports to place 2.28 mln new shares.

text.p: British port operator Forth Ports Plc said on Thursday that it had agreed to place 2.28 million shares of 50 pence each at a price of 600 pence to raise an aggregate of 13.6 million stg.
The new ordinary shares represent about five percent of the company's current issued share capital.
The shares are being placed through de Zoete & Bevan Ltd. Dealings in the new shares are expected to start on May 19.
Forth Ports said the money would partially fund some of its plans to develop new business.
